problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

The parallelogram $P$ is mapped to the parallelogram ${P}^{′}$ under the action of $T.$ The parallelogram ${P}^{′}$ has vertices $(1,1),(0,0),(-1,1),$ and $(0,2).$ Which of the following are vertices of $P?$

- $(0,-1)$
- $(1,1)$
- $(-1,0)$
